title: AgentFund task manifest (spec_version 1)
description: One unit of work. Lives at tasks/<id>.yaml in the project repo. The worker builds the sandbox from this document and runs nothing outside it.

spec_version.description: Manifest format version. Workers reject unknown versions.

id.description: Unique within the repo. NNNN-slug; the number is an ordering hint only. Must equal the file name without the .yaml extension.

title.description: Short human label for UI and PR titles.

prompt.description: The full instruction given to the agent, verbatim.

write.description: Globs (repo-relative, doublestar syntax) the agent may create, modify or delete. Any change outside them discards the run.

read.description: Globs present read-only in the sandbox beyond the write scope. Omitted = whole repo read-only.

verify.description: Shell command run in the sandbox (sh -c, repo root as cwd) after the agent finishes. Exit 0 = pass.

max_tokens.description: Hard spend cap for this task (input + output, including cache reads/writes). The worker kills the run at the cap.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must be in state `merged` before this one is claimable.

base_branch.description: Branch to fork from and open the PR against.

glob.description: Repo-relative path glob. `*` matches within a segment, `**` across segments. No leading `/`, no `..` segments, never inside `.git/`.
